name: io.github.JSv4/docxodus
description: Open, read, edit, compare and redline Word .docx files locally, with native tracked changes.

environmentVariables.name: DOCXODUS_STORAGE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Directory every document path must resolve inside. Defaults to the user's home directory.

environmentVariables.name: DOCXODUS_STORAGE_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional single path segment appended to the storage root, to keep one server's documents apart from another's.
